title: El Salvador’s National Bitcoin Office Hosts Five November Events Led by Herbert and Keiser
summary: Bitcoin Magazine El Salvador’s National Bitcoin Office Hosts Five November Events Led by Herbert and Keiser El Salvador’s National Bitcoin Office, led by Stacey Herbert and Max Keiser, has scheduled five Bitcoin-focused events from November 10–20, including Bitcoin Histórico at the National Palace and a new Renaissance Rodeo. This post El Salvador’s National Bitcoin Office Hosts Five November Events Led by Herbert and Keiser first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .
